mentions.name: Dead Chefs Society
mentions.description: This monthly dinner club gathers members at Long Island restaurants for 10+ course meals focused on a theme or region of the world, working with each restaurant to craft menus as authentic to the region as possible. Dinners are held on slow weeknights to drive business to local restaurants, and the club has grown from 13 friends to about 1,000 members while generating roughly $140k for restaurants. It is evolving into a lifestyle brand for food lovers, with a clothing line and a newly launched website.
mentions.problem: People who love food want to experience authentic regional cuisines from around the world without getting on a plane.
mentions.audience: Food lovers / people who love food
mentions.source_excerpt: In 2023 a friend and I started a monthly dinner club with the goal of eating around the world without getting on a plane. We gather once a month at a restaurant on Long Island for a meal focused on a theme or region of the world. The meals are around 10+ courses and include a drink. We work with the restaurant to craft a menu that is as close to authentic to the region as possible.
